import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.DataFrame(pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv'))

# Create a bar chart to compare sleep duration across different gender groups
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.barplot(data=data, x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Quality of Sleep')
plt.title('Sleep Duration Across Different Gender Groups')
plt.xlabel('Gender')
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.legend(title='Quality of Sleep')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a scatter plot to compare physical activity level and heart rate across different age groups
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Age', y='Heart Rate', hue='Physical Activity Level')
plt.title('Physical Activity Level and Heart Rate Across Different Age Groups')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
plt.legend(title='Physical Activity Level')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a box plot to compare daily steps across different BMI categories
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='BMI Category', y='Daily Steps')
plt.title('Daily Steps Across Different BMI Categories')
plt.xlabel('BMI Category')
plt.ylabel('Daily Steps')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
